location: Chapter 10, The Athens of South America
text_en: The Bogotános have long claimed for their city the distinction of being the Athens of South America. And considering its past and present culture, and the attention which the arts, the sciences and literature have always received there since the foundation of the capital, few, I think, will be disposed to impugn the justness of this claim.
text_zh: 波哥大人早就宣称他们的城市配得上“南美的雅典”之名。想想它过去和现在的文化，想想自首都建城以来艺术、科学和文学在这里一直受到的重视，我想，很少有人会质疑这一说法是否公道。

location: Chapter 12, The Valley of the Magdalena
location_zh: 第 12 章《马格达莱纳河谷》
text_en: The town of Mompos is probably the most remarkable example of this kind. Founded in 1539 by Alonso de Heredia, it is one of the oldest towns in the republic, and was for generations the most important commercial centre between Cartagena and Honda. But owing to a displacement of the main channel of the river, and the filling in of the branch of the river on which the town was built, it is now practically deprived of its former means of communication with the rest of the country, and is rapidly verging towards extinction.
text_zh: 蒙波斯镇大概是这类情形中最引人注目的例子。它由阿隆索·德·埃雷迪亚建于 1539 年，是这个共和国最古老的城镇之一，好几代人以来都是卡塔赫纳和翁达之间最重要的商业中心。但由于河的主航道改了道，小镇所在的那条支流又被淤塞，如今它几乎断绝了与国内其他地方往来的通道，正迅速走向消亡。

text_en: Facing a firing squad many years later, Colonel Aureliano Buendía remembers the afternoon his father took him to see ice for the first time, back when Macondo was a village of a few mud-and-cane houses on the bank of a clear river.
text_zh: 多年以后，面对行刑队，奥雷里亚诺·布恩迪亚上校想起了父亲带他去见识冰块的那个下午；那时的马孔多还只是河岸边几座泥巴和芦苇搭成的房子。

text_en: Back from a long journey, Fermina Daza is shopping in the crowded Arcade of the Scribes when Florentino Ariza comes up behind her; she turns, sees him close up for the first time, and realizes in an instant that what she felt for him was an illusion.
text_zh: 远行归来的费尔米纳·达萨在人声嘈杂的代笔人门廊买东西，弗洛伦蒂诺·阿里萨走到她身后；她回过头，第一次这样近地看清了他，一瞬间明白自己对他的感情不过是一场幻觉。

text_en: On the morning the bishop's boat is due, Santiago Nasar gets up at five-thirty, while the Vicario twins are already telling half the town that they are going to kill him.
text_zh: 主教的船要来的那天早上，圣地亚哥·纳赛尔五点半就起了床，而维卡里奥家的孪生兄弟已经在镇上逢人便说要杀了他。

text_en: After six years at school in Bogotá, Efraín rides home to his father's hacienda in the Cauca Valley and finds his cousin María, whom he left a child, grown into a young woman; she has put fresh roses in his room.
text_zh: 在波哥大念了六年书之后，埃弗拉因骑马回到父亲在考卡山谷的庄园，发现当年还是个孩子的表妹玛丽亚已经长成了少女；她在他的房间里摆了新摘的玫瑰。
